content.title: Imperfect Day Memory Variant | Route, Weather Crest, Quiet Departure
content.summary: This is an evidence variant of the existing imperfect memory farewell. Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three clothing, carried-object or gait anchors across at least five ordinary chapters. Use one object, route direction, weather transition or repeated movement to connect each chapter. Preserve bounded handheld imperfections—late pans, partial occlusions, focus recovery and uneven horizons—without losing the subject. Let activity density decrease after one weather or emotional crest and end on a quieter departure or hold. Do not copy source person, city, streetcar, basketball, storm, diner, rooftop, exact camera or timing.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original subject with at least three stable anchors across five ordinary chapters. + Connect each chapter with one object, route direction, weather change or repeated motion. + Use bounded handheld imperfections but always recover subject and anchor. + Place one weather or emotional crest before decreasing activity density. + End on a quiet departure or hold with the same adult and at least one anchor visible.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one original clearly adult harbor courier with a red thermos, canvas satchel and cream cap drinking dawn tea beside a ferry timetable; allow a slightly uneven handheld horizon. A sudden fog front crosses the yard as the adult secures one tarp; permit brief focus hunting through droplets, then restore the same face and clothing anchors. Follow the same adult toward a breakwater at dusk with satchel and cap still visible. Slow to a side hold as the adult walks out of frame; no source man, New Orleans, streetcar, basketball, diner or rooftop.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source young adult man, face, clothes, backpack and gait
source coffee, streetcar, basketball and diner actions
source New Orleans-like streets, court, storm and rooftop
source exact handheld errors, focus recovery and chapter order
source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording, timing and camera
